title: Restaurant identity film

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is a poster frame

slide_intent: Carry a visual identity into physical navigation so visitors can recognize the place and understand where to go.
strategic_value: Warm stripes, signatures and materials can connect Burger King’s exterior, drive-through and counter experiences.
demonstration: The film moves from colored bands into restaurant renderings, pavement arrows, facade lettering, counters and illuminated exterior views.
practical_value: Compare the identity’s role at arrival, navigation and ordering distances.

content_islands.name: Graphic introduction
content_islands.spec: Open with stacked brown, red and orange bands on cream.

content_islands.name: Exterior and navigation
content_islands.spec: Sequence restaurant exteriors, drive-through paths and striped pavement arrows.

content_islands.name: Interior and evening
content_islands.spec: Show facade detail, counter signage and day-to-night views before returning to the bands.

reference_purposes.Application: Restaurant renderings show the palette and signatures on buildings, pavement guidance and ordering surfaces.
reference_purposes.Expression: The same warm bands link the film transitions with physical navigation.

ingredient.name: Striped environmental graphics
ingredient.application: Observe how the bands become pavement arrows and edge treatments around restaurant architecture.
ingredient.scope: JKR case-study renderings; not a dimensional wayfinding or building specification.
